name: @conform/submission-video
description: Intro and closing animations for Conform's submission video (Remotion). All sound is synthesized by scripts/make-audio.mjs: no third-party music or samples.

scripts.studio: pnpm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:intro: pnpm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts Intro ../intro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:outro: pnpm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts Outro ../outro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render: pnpm run render:intro && pnpm run render:outro
scripts.stills: remotion still src/index.ts Intro ../stills/intro-2-keystone.png --frame=118 && remotion still src/index.ts Outro ../stills/outro-1-checks.png --frame=112
scripts.render:outro:url: pnpm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts Outro ../outro.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --props="{\"url\":\"$CONFORM_URL\"}"
